hypothesis: majority counts only pass and fail against the seat count, so an inconclusive vote and an odd round are read wrong. Fix: an outcome wins with more than half of all votes cast, inconclusive votes in the total (the page's rule), in council.ts majority.

command: pnpm driftbench validate judges --seed 1 --items --all-levels --json (seed-1 measurement; full 1..20 and hidden run pending)
hypothesis: majority ignores judge weights, so a weighted round is read as a plain count. Fix: majority takes { weights }: a vote weighs its judge's weight (default 1), an outcome wins with more than half the total weight, and a weight that is negative or not finite throws a RangeError.

Fix: export comparePair(judge, { criterion, a, b }) that asks a pair judge in both orders and returns the agreed winner, a tie when both say tie, else inconclusive; a judge that throws gives inconclusive.
